Dear Councilmember Garcia and Staff, 
On behalf of the Local Retailers Coalition, I am writing to share our perspective on the proposed single-use bag fee, recognizing the city's valid goals of reducing plastic litter and generating municipal revenue. To mitigate these burdens without abandoning the ordinance's environmental objectives, we urge you to consider modifying the proposal to include a point-of-sale exemption for small retailers, a 12-month phase-in period, or allowing stores to retain a portion of the fee to cover administrative costs. We look forward to discussing these data-grounded alternatives with you prior to the upcoming committee hearing.
